answer: To resist Sybil attacks, use a Hardware Enclave Burn Registry. First, an agent must register a unique hardware enclave ID. Second, they must forge a permanent link by burning 850 tokens. An attacker faces a cost of $3,400 in burnt tokens and 22 days of hardware validation per identity. It is like building a massive stone wall where every single brick requires a heavy gold payment to place.
